description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.document class, representing a DOM document with methods for manipulating document elements, styles, and content.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.document
classes.description: Represents a DOM document with methods to manipulate and access document elements, styles, and content.

methods.name: appendStyleSheet
methods.description: Appends a CSS stylesheet to the document.

methods.name: appendStyleText
methods.description: Appends CSS style text to the document.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a new DOM element with optional attributes and styles.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the document's window.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an element by its ID.

methods.name: getByAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a node based on an address array.

methods.name: getElementsByTag
methods.description: Retrieves elements by tag name and optional namespace.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the <head> element of the document.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the <body> element of the document.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object associated with the document.
